caseName: Serve Yourself Gasoline Stations Ass'n v. Brock
caseNameFull: Serve Yourself Gasoline Stations Association, Inc. v. Brock, Director of the Department of Agriculture of California Delay v. California
attorneys: Edward S. Shattuck for appellants. Edmund G. Brown, Attorney General of California, and Frank J. Mackin, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees. John F. Hassler, Deputy Attorney General, was also of counsel for appellees in No. 676.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of California; and

Appeal from the Superior Court in and for the County of Los Angeles, California.

Per Curiam:

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeals are dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.
